draft.emotion: helpful and prompt, handing over a message
notes: Often used with the prefix 'op-' ('opsturen') when sending something by mail or parcel.

senses.definition: To cause a message, letter, or package to go or be taken to someone.

examples.text: Ik zal je vanavond een e-mail sturen.
examples.translation: I will send you an email tonight.

senses.definition: To guide or control the direction of a vehicle, bicycle, or boat.

examples.text: Het is lastig om met één hand te sturen op de fiets.
examples.translation: It is difficult to steer with one hand on a bicycle.

draftBefore.shortGloss: to send; to steer, to drive
draftBefore.emotion: helpful and prompt, handing over a message
notes: Sturen has two very common meanings: sending something (like a message or a package) and steering a vehicle or bicycle.
Do not confuse sturen (to send/steer) with wandelen (to walk) or reizen (to travel).
